Minesweeper Game

A full Minesweeper game — three difficulties, real mine placement, flood-fill reveals, flagging, and win/lose detection.

📖 How to use

  1. Pick a difficulty and press New game.
  2. Click cells to reveal — numbers show adjacent mines.
  3. Right-click (or toggle 🚩 mode) to flag suspected mines.
  4. Reveal every safe cell to win. Avoid the 💣!

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which difficulties are available?

Beginner (9×9, 10 mines), Intermediate (16×16, 40 mines) and Expert (16×30, 99 mines).

How do I flag a mine?

Left-click (or tap) reveals a cell; right-click (or long-press / the 🚩 toggle) places a flag.

Is the first click always safe?

Yes — the first cell you reveal is always safe, along with its neighbors.

How do I win?

You win by revealing every non-mine cell. Flagging all mines is not required.
